info.summary: Batch 650 — Voice engine and keyboard commands: Report Draft phrases, replace-once dictation, say-it-twice, voice audit, eligibility parity, screen handlers for registered commands
info.description: Vitest, 2026-10-23: full suite 1767 files, 14,789 tests (14,777 passed; the one explicit-any guard failure found in that run has since been fixed). Type-check clean. Targeted run of the 16 test files listed here (changed in Batches 650 to 652): all passed.

tests.comment:
PASSED: Report Draft spoken phrases (20 commands, six languages) register in the action registry and Enter Gross / Micro / Diagnosis reach their section.
PASSED: src/services/voice/reportDraftVoiceActions.test.ts (8)
PASSED: src/services/voice/dictationSectionPicker.test.ts (5)
PASSED: src/pages/SynopticReportPage/hooks/useReportDraftVoiceActions.test.tsx (8)
Not tested or not built: Real microphone and speech recognition; Enter Addendum, Insert Macro, Next/Previous Field (no voice handler); Enter Gross/Diagnosis on the synoptic layout (no free-text box); the Mic button with a field in focus on Intraop / Verbal Report.

PASSED: AI refinement replaces the dictated text once (one final insert per segment, 2,000 ms budget); the writer does not insert both raw and refined text.
PASSED: src/services/voice/dictationSegmentFlow.test.ts (11)
Not tested or not built: A real TipTap editor in a browser; dictation into a plain text box (still shows nothing until final text).

PASSED: A corrected dictated phrase is recorded on blur and reused in the Report Draft and Microscopic entry as well as Internal Notes.
PASSED: src/services/voice/dictationCorrections.test.ts (3)
Not tested or not built: Cross-session persistence on the server; native-speaker review of learned phrases.

PASSED: Six hard-to-undo commands ask to be said twice; second hearing within the window runs it; another phrase or silence cancels; keys are unaffected.
PASSED: src/services/voice/voiceCommandRunner.test.ts (14)
Not tested or not built: Which commands belong on the list (a decision for Pete); Delete Row has no Worklist feature behind it.

PASSED: getEligibleActions and findActionByTrigger share commandEligibility: screen in focus, always-on, functional area and action group; a phrase for another screen is refused with 'Not available on this screen'.
PASSED: src/services/actionRegistry/voiceStationEligibility.test.ts (7)
Not tested or not built: Server-side eligibility; real station configuration screens.

PASSED: Voice command executed / refused events carry action id, screen, person and refusal reason, never speech or a case.
PASSED: src/services/voice/voiceCommandAudit.test.ts (3)
Not tested or not built: Server-written audit entry (none exists); a Mohs stage answer by voice is not audited.

PASSED: Registered commands now reach the screen: Sign Out Case (opens the window, never signs), History, Codes, Finalise, Add Amendment, Search execute/clear, eight TAT tiles; ignored when the button is greyed or a window is open (modalFocus).
PASSED: src/services/reports/bottomBarActions.test.ts (18)
PASSED: src/pages/SynopticReportPage/hooks/useBottomBarActionEvents.test.tsx (7)
PASSED: src/services/quality/tatTileActions.test.ts (3)
PASSED: src/services/actionRegistry/screenActionWiring.test.ts (6)
PASSED: src/utils/modalFocus.test.ts (9)
Not tested or not built: A real browser key press; the 29 commands still unwired (listed in KNOWN_GAPS.md); Sign Out and Next in Orchestration (no button).

PASSED: A build test fails when a registered command has neither a listener nor an entry in unwiredActions.ts, and when a listed command has since been wired.
PASSED: src/services/actionRegistry/actionListeners.guard.test.ts (5)
Not tested or not built: Does not check that a listener does the right thing, only that one exists.

PASSED: Accept (Alt+A) and Pass (Ctrl+Alt+P) reach the pool claim window over the Worklist and the report; nothing is accepted with the window closed.
